question: Does the sentiment score lead, coincide with, or lag price?
method: Hourly change in average_compound vs hourly log return (Coinbase SYMBOL-USD candles), cross-correlation at offsets -12h..+12h. Positive offset = price moves after sentiment (sentiment leads). Significance uses a Bonferroni-corrected threshold across all 25 offsets. Script: scripts/leadlag.py.
honest_prior: Scored from published news headlines, so the expectation is coincident-to-lagging. Results will be published here whatever they show.
